description:
A beautifully presented one double bedroom flat enviably located on the second floor of a popular residential development on pleasant street between Hackney and Dalston. Recently refurbished the apartment features a bright open-plan reception/kitchen area, a spacious double bedroom and modern bathroom. Located just a short walk away from Dalston Junction, Dalston Kingsland and Hackney downs stations as well as from all the shops and amenities of nearby Dalston.

There is a water meter at this property.

There is no parking included at this property – Interested applicants are advised to check with the local authority for information about any available permit parking.

All known suppliers for mobile phone and broadband services are available in this area. Information regarding broadband options and phone signal can be obtained from the Ofcom broadband and mobile coverage checker. Please contact us for further details.

It is not permitted for a tenant to register a company to the property or operate a business trade or profession from the property.
